# Fixture P3-PASS-ORDINARY

At closing time, Lin notices that Mei left her lunch card on the classroom desk. Lin asks the custodian to keep the room open while she checks the lost-property box. Mei remembers placing the card there after lunch; they find it together and walk to the bus stop. The next morning, Mei brings Lin the tea she promised, and Lin returns the favor by saving her a seat.

This fixture is ordinary daily life. It has no anomaly, investigation, or abnormal response. Its causal chain is explicit: the missing card prompts a search, the remembered action locates it, and the friends' reciprocal promises pay off the ending.
